test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q and R alone can do a piece of work in 5, 6 and 4 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but Q left 1 days before completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
solution:
Given: 

P, Q and R alone can do a piece of work in 5, 6 and 4 days respectively

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of 5, 6 and 4 = 60

Efficiency of P = 60/5 = 12

Efficiency of Q = 60/6 = 10

Efficiency of R = 60/4 = 15

Let the work be completed in x days.

According to the question,

⇒ 12 × x + 10 × (x - 1) + 15 × x = 60 

⇒ 37x = 70

x = 70/37

∴ The answer is 70/37 days.
